lines: Here's an old tune and a job to do. Press Play to hear it, then tap a block to change who plays what.
Amber means a real band would trip there. Tap the light to see where.
Every change gets a reason. Tap one, or type your own.
That'll work. Every check is green.
Same plan, new job. See what the checks say now.
Here's your program. Press Play to hear the final version.
Tap a role and a dynamic. Use Octave for Melody or Bass, then close the editor.
Tap an instrument to add a player. Then tap its blocks to give it a part.
Tap a section to add it. Tap its heading in the grid to move it or play from there.
Press Play to listen. Tap a block to edit a part, or tap a check to see what needs work.
Press Play to hear your program, or press Back to Arrange to revise it.
Press Play from here to hear this section onward. Close the editor to keep arranging.
Use Solo to hear this player alone during Play. Close the editor to keep arranging.
Clear this occasion's arrangement? Press Clear, or press Keep to return to your plan.
Tap an available role and a dynamic, then close the editor.
